title: Paraty Brazil by UTMB 2027 — How to get there (official)
publisher: Paraty Brazil by UTMB / UTMB World Series
claims: Paraty is about four hours by car from both São Paulo International Airport (GRU) and Rio de Janeiro International Airport (GIG).
The official page gives 269 km from São Paulo to Paraty and 263 km from Rio de Janeiro to Paraty, each with a drive time of about four hours.
The official page lists bus, rental car and private transfer as the ways to reach Paraty, and says the roads are well maintained.
The official page publishes an event arena map link and a parking-lot map link.
